sources.title: Qwen 3.6 Complete Guide: 27B Dense, 35B-A3B MoE, and Which to Use
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.6 landed in two open-weight flavors: 27B dense and 35B-A3B MoE. Benchmarks, hardware fit, and which variant to run on your GPU.

sources.title: GitHub - AtomicBot-ai/atomic-llama-cpp-turboquant: llama.cpp fork with ...
sources.snippet: The matrix bench shows that turbo3 KV + NextN is the recommended default on the MoE target (Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B, +24-36 % tps over the turbo3-base baseline at single-slot), and lifts the dense Qwen 3.6 27B by ~5 % on top of turbo3-base despite the model being draft-compute-bound.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B — vllm-ascend
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is a sparse MoE model in the Qwen3.6 family. It has 35B total parameters with about 3B activated per token, and uses the same hybrid attention architecture (GDN + full attention) as Qwen3.5.
